Main palette: [Warm sand + cyan / Deep blue / Forest green + umber / Ice blue + white]
Title: [Main English title]

Create a premium 9:16 editorial poster from the WORLD SLICE series.

Show a realistic natural landscape as if a section of the world has been physically cut open, revealing a much larger hidden structure beneath the visible surface.

Keep the surface relatively simple and easy to read, while the hidden section becomes the main visual surprise. Use strong scale contrast, clear geological or ecological layers, realistic materials, believable depth, atmospheric perspective and cinematic natural light.

The cutaway should not look like a glass box or aquarium. Treat it as a real piece of land, ocean, forest or ice physically sliced from the planet.

Let parts of nature break beyond the geometric cutaway boundary: roots, rock formations, ice, water or terrain may extend outside the original shape to create stronger visual impact.

Keep the central object around 55–70% of the poster width and preserve generous negative space. Avoid making the 3D cutaway too large.

Integrate typography into the composition instead of adding many tiny labels. Use one bold main title, one short supporting line and only a few minimal editorial details. Allow natural elements to overlap, pass behind or partially cover the typography.

Use a refined mix of modern serif and condensed sans-serif typography. The poster should feel like premium nature editorial design, contemporary art direction and photorealistic environmental visualization.

Prioritize:
strong thumbnail readability, one clear visual surprise, large recognizable forms, realistic natural textures, clean hierarchy, high-end editorial composition, and a strong contrast between the visible world and the hidden world.

No logo, no watermark, no numbering, no excessive micro text, no HUD interface, no four-point sparkle symbols, no cheap CGI, no glass-container look.

Make the final image feel like a complete finished poster, not a template.

Create a bold commercial campaign poster where **the product itself becomes the starting point of the perspective system**.

Create clear foreground–subject–background layering. Allow selected parts of the product or typography to move in front of the subject while other parts remain behind, creating real dimensional depth without excessive fragmentation.

【跨栏元素】：花枝 / 主体轮廓 / 声场线 / 建筑线 / 水路 / 其他

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「竖三栏 / 左中右构图」。

重点不是把三个内容分别塞进三个栏，而是先用不等宽三栏建立清晰秩序，再通过主体、图像、线条、空间或无形视觉元素突破栏线，让三个区域重新形成一个完整画面。

可根据主题灵活使用以下方式：

图像越栏：传统绘画、花枝、鸟羽、植物或其他图像主体主要位于一至两个栏位，但局部必须主动突破边界，与其他色栏和 Typography 产生穿插关系。

主体偏置：大型文物、雕塑或人物明显压在其中一侧，另一侧通过年代、材质、档案文字和研究图建立视觉重量。主体可以侵入相邻栏位，但不要机械居中。

现象跨栏：实体主体停留在一侧，让声音、光线、烟气、水纹、运动轨迹等无形元素成为真正连接三栏的视觉线索。线条需要有明确来源、方向和传播逻辑，不要变成科技 UI 或随机装饰。

近中远空间：让三个栏分别承担近景、中景和远景，通过枝条、墙线、水路、石径、建筑轴线或视线连续跨栏，使三个区域看起来属于同一个空间，而不是三张照片拼贴。

三栏比例不要平均，根据主题使用例如 24/30/46、28/22/50、38/34/28 等不同关系。每一栏可以拥有不同背景色、信息密度和视觉重量，但整体必须平衡。

Typography 根据画面内容重新设计。可以使用横向跨栏标题、中等尺度标题、局部反色、图像压字、文字被主体轻微遮挡等方式。不要每张都使用超大单字，也不要固定使用四字纵排或“两字横排 + 两字竖排”。

信息密度参考成熟博物馆海报、艺术图录和 Editorial Design。可加入英文副标题、材质、年代、结构、日期、场馆、策展短句以及少量研究内容。

研究信息应与主题直接相关，例如：

文物测绘、纹样放大、材质档案、声学传播、近中远关系、建筑剖面或空间视线。

面积保持克制，作为第二层阅读内容，不要抢主视觉，也不要做成百科或 PPT。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色。优先使用大面积纯净色域，例如骨白、赭红、朱砂、深青蓝、墨绿、青铜绿等。主体颜色、栏位颜色与 Typography 之间必须形成清楚层级。

核心原则：三栏负责建立秩序，跨栏元素负责打破边界，主体负责视觉重量，信息负责完成作品内容。

整体要求：9:16，高清、清晰、色块干净、主体完整、文字与细线锐利、信息丰富但有秩序，具有真正成熟的文化展览海报与艺术图录完成度。

避免：机械三等分、三个独立卡片、三张图片拼贴感、主体全部困在栏内、固定标题模板、PPT 信息框、科技 HUD、随机跨栏线、无意义小字、过度做旧、斑驳噪点、复杂 UI 和低完成度 AI 海报感。

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 cinematic portrait poster built around atmosphere, light, reflection and emotional typography.

Start with a strong film-like portrait rather than a posed fashion photo. The subject should feel caught inside a real moment — looking through glass, standing in reflected city light, separated by shadow, or partially hidden by the environment. Keep natural skin texture, believable hair, expressive eyes and realistic lighting.

Use one main visual interference to shape the mood. This could be rain on glass, an incomplete reflection, a strong light leak, hard leaf shadows, a split moment between two portraits, soft bloom or controlled foreground blur. The effect should change how the portrait is perceived rather than simply decorate it.

Let part of the image remain clear while another part becomes hazy, reflected, overexposed or partially obscured. Controlled imperfection is important — the viewer should not see everything immediately.

Keep the color grading cinematic and distinctive. Cool blue, cyan, moss green, olive, steel grey or other restrained tones can dominate, while skin remains natural. Avoid muddy shadows and overly yellow or orange grading.

Typography should behave like part of the image. Mix an elegant serif or clean sans serif with one expressive handwritten phrase. Let text cross reflections, fade into light, overlap faces, extend beyond the frame or move across two photographic layers. Do not place every line neatly in empty space.

Keep supporting copy minimal — one strong title, one handwritten phrase and one short emotional sentence are enough.

The final image should feel somewhere between a film still, an art-house movie poster and a fashion editorial: atmospheric, intimate, visually layered and emotionally unresolved.

Avoid generic portrait layouts, excessive small text, rigid sidebars, fake movie credits, heavy UI graphics, random effects, image numbering, Vol./Issue labels, four-point sparkle symbols, logos and watermarks.

生成一张具有成熟 Editorial Design 与展览视觉质感的左右构图海报。

不要简单把画面切成左右两栏，而是让左右两个视觉区域表达同一个主题的不同状态，并让“中间边界”成为变化真正发生的位置。

左右区域采用不等比例布局，根据主体重量使用 40:60、45:55、55:45 等关系，不要机械 50:50。左侧负责建立起点或原始状态，右侧负责展示变化后的结果，例如：
正面作品 → 背后的结构与制作路径；
设计草图 → 建成后的真实空间；
声源主体 → 向外扩散的振动与声场；
真实实体 → 纸面上的拓印、痕迹或图像。

最重要的是中轴转译。不要用明显竖线分隔，而要选择一个核心元素穿过左右区域，并在跨越中轴时连续发生变化.

例如：花瓣逐渐化成针脚和丝线；建筑线稿逐渐变成真实墙面；器物震动逐渐扩散成声纹；石刻浮雕逐渐压平成为黑墨拓印。

这种变化必须连续、自然，让观众一眼理解左右两边存在因果、过程或转译关系，而不是两张无关图片拼在一起。

Typography 也参与左右关系，但所有文字必须属于作品本身。使用真正的作品标题、副标题、短句和展览信息，不出现“左右构图”“设计案例”“视觉研究”等模板占位文字。

图像较重的一侧减少信息，较空的一侧可以承担更多标题与文字，通过字体大小、密度和位置完成视觉配重。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系。左右可以有明显明暗、冷暖或材质差异，但至少保留一种颜色、纹理或视觉元素跨越中轴，保证整张作品统一。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到左右两种明显不同的视觉状态；第二眼发现中轴处正在发生连接和变化；第三眼理解“左边为什么会变成右边”；最后再阅读标题与作品信息。

整体要求：两个视觉域各有作用，中间有明确转译过程，左右不平均但视觉平衡，既有内容逻辑，也有成熟作品感。

整张画面设置约 4–7 个主要视觉锚点，并允许加入更多微型信息颗粒。必须保持明确主次：第一视觉锚点承担约 30%–40% 的视觉重量，第二、第三锚点明显次一级，其他元素作为小型散点穿插。通过至少 3 个尺度层级制造节奏：超大标题 / 主体 → 中型图像或物件 → 极小文字、数字、标签和细节，不要让所有元素尺寸接近。

根据内容选择合适的散点方式：同类元素可通过大小、方向、距离和局部裁切形成节奏，不做规则网格；实体物件利用不同轮廓、材质和视觉重量错落排列；数字、时间、坐标和数据可打散到不同区域，用字号与颜色建立跳读路径；碎片结构可围绕一个隐形整体排列，通过负空间、局部轮廓或纹样连续关系，让观众主动补全完整形态。

画面信息可以丰富，但不要平均分布。建议形成 2–3 个高密度区域、1 个中等密度区域，并保留至少 20%–30% 的安静空间。建立 3–4 条隐形纵向或横向基线，让标题、图片边缘、数字和标签在视觉上暗中对齐；允许主动打破网格，但必须先有网格逻辑。加入约 3–4 处有控制的穿插关系，例如文字局部被主体遮挡、图片压住标题边缘、标签与物件轻微叠压、色块或线条跨过不同信息区域。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系，不要平均使用颜色。确定一个主结构色，再让同一种强调色分散出现在不同区域，通过远距离颜色呼应把视觉散点重新连接起来。Typography 需要有明确层级：大型中文标题承担主要视觉重量，英文标题建立第二层结构，数字和日期可成为独立视觉锚点，正文与标签保持较小字号；允许横排、纵排、局部旋转和裁切，但不要随机旋转所有文字。

所有文字必须属于作品本身，例如时间、地点、材质、观察记录、作品短句、对象名称或相关数据，不出现“散点构图”“设计案例”“Visual Study”“Composition”“Series 01”等模板占位文字。最终第一眼应看到 1–2 个强视觉锚点，第二眼开始在不同散点之间跳跃，第三眼发现颜色、尺寸、方向和信息之间的呼应；放大后仍然有第二层、第三层细节可以阅读。

整体要求：高信息密度、杂而不乱、多锚点但主次明确、丰富、有节奏、有作品感，像成熟的艺术展览海报、独立出版物或 Editorial Poster。避免规则九宫格、平均撒元素、所有内容一样大、每个区域都塞满、PPT 信息块、无意义英文、过多边框、随机贴纸拼贴和主次不分。

CREATE TEMP VIEW subject_analysis AS

  INFER_INTERNAL_ZONES(:SUBJECT)         AS zones,
  INFER_TINY_ACTORS(:SUBJECT)            AS actors,
  INFER_SYMBOLIC_PROPS(:SUBJECT)         AS props,
  INFER_MOVEMENT_PATHS(:SUBJECT)         AS routes;

CREATE TEMP VIEW plate_base AS
SELECT
  BUILD_SERVING_STAGE(
    plate = 'matte black ceramic plate',
    ground = 'sushi rice terrain with sesame scatter',
    lighting = 'premium food photography, dark background, soft overhead highlights'
  ) AS plate

CREATE TEMP VIEW edible_structure AS
SELECT
  CONVERT_TO_SUSHI_ARCHITECTURE(
    silhouette,
    material_map = ARRAY[
      'pressed rice blocks for walls and mass',
      'salmon and tuna sashimi for smooth surfaces',
      'tamago for roofs, panels, platforms',
      'nori strips for beams, supports, outlines, flags',

提示词：
【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【核心动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】9:16 竖版

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」作为核心视觉方法。

背景使用温润、干净的暖象牙白手工纸，保留极轻天然纤维和细腻纸浆纹理。画面主动保留约 45%–60% 的大面积留白，让空白本身成为构图的一部分，不使用大量山水、植物、建筑或装饰元素填满背景。

使用【核心大色域】作为画面的第一视觉主体。大色域占据约 25%–40% 的画面，根据【海报主题】可以表现为幕布、嵌套层、长轴、薄纸、纸浆、器物结构或其他抽象大形，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域必须拥有真实而高级的手工纸材料感，包括天然长短纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、大尺度自然色差、轻微压痕、自然毛边与哑光表面。材质丰富但保持干净、完整，不做脏旧、黄斑、严重破损、随机斑驳、强噪点或廉价复古效果。

整体主色使用【主色调】，颜色数量保持克制。低饱和但色面必须完整、有浓度，不要把“东方感”理解成褪色、灰蒙或陈旧。可以设置一枚极小朱砂红印记或一个极小暖色节点作为点睛，总面积控制在画面 1%–2%。

在大色域附近加入一个尺度非常小但叙事完整的【微型文化场景】。人物、桌面、工具和器物整体只占画面约 3%–5%，让观者远看先看到大形和留白，靠近后才发现人物正在完成【核心动作】。

所有人物必须采用二维纸本淡彩插画语言，与整张海报使用同一种纸、同一套颜料和同一个画师般的视觉语言。人物面部只用少量克制线点概括五官，不刻画真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、眼球高光或摄影式面部阴影。

人物身体只使用轻微二维明暗表达基础体积，服装主要使用完整、低饱和、哑光的平面色块，仅加入少量连续自然的线性衣褶。人物脚下只保留非常淡的贴纸接触阴影。

禁止摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 体积感、塑料皮肤、电影光影、强轮廓光、摄影景深和强投影。人物必须像直接画在纸上的东方编辑插画。

根据主题加入少量【文化器物】，器物真正参与人物动作，不做整齐商品陈列，不堆满工作台。器物、人物与场景均保持纸本淡彩和轻工笔质感。

在微型场景和巨大主视觉之间建立一个清楚但克制的“尺度连接”。可以根据主题使用一根琴弦、操偶杆、纤维、漆线、纸边、工具轨迹或其他真实来源的细线，将微型手工行为视觉上连接到巨大色域。

连接元素必须有真实起点、完整走势和明确终点，不得漂浮、断裂或作为无意义装饰。

主标题【主标题】放在大面积留白区域，使用纤细、端正、具有现代东方文化机构气质的中文宋体或明朝体。标题保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，让文字成为第二视觉层级。

标题上方可加入极小英文活动类别，标题下方加入一行简短中文副题。日期、地点与活动信息使用更小字号集中排布在边缘留白区，形成真实文化海报的信息层级。

整体风格融合手工纸拼贴、水彩或矿物颜料肌理、二维纸本淡彩插画、微型文化叙事与现代东方编辑设计。

prompts.text:
视频自媒体刚需！这篇教程要收好！！
AI自动剪辑，然后自动排期发布，一整套！！

Astra + 达芬奇MCP，是目前最可能实现“AI自动剪辑成片直接能用”的组合技！！
至少比那些所谓的“自动剪辑插件”要好的多！

整个流程里，Astra 理解需求，通过 DaVinci Resolve MCP 操作剪辑软件，配套的 editing skills 则提供具体的剪辑思路。

教程使用的是开源的第三方 MCP，搭建时需要根据自己的电脑和达芬奇版本检查配置。
连接好之后，先确认AI打开的项目正不正确，确认后，再开始处理素材。
然后把各种素材放进同一个文件夹，然后告诉 AI：
你卖什么、视频给谁看，以及希望别人看完之后做什么。

不要着急出片！
几乎所有的视频教程，都会说到这个！
如果实际用AI生成过这种落地视频，就应该有体会！！
先做一小段，确定画面、字体、音效等符合自己的要求，然后再开始下一步，如果有调整，及时给参考图让AI修正。
这会少走很多弯路，也会节约不少Token！

成片完成后，教程可以通过 Blotato 自动排期发布，自此就完成了整个流程。
这套工作流倒是不算很新鲜，不过对于有店铺、或者有固定品牌需要视频营销的人来说，真的非常实用！
因为很多东西都是可复用的！品牌资料、确认过的风格都留在文件夹里，下次上新品、换菜单、做活动，再补充新素材和新需求。

文中用到的 达芬奇MCP 已经开源了，值得研究一下：
https://github.com/samuelgursky/davinci-resolve-mcp

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where the main word is generated by real physical forces and structural deformation.

The title should dominate roughly 35–55% of the composition and remain bold and readable from one precise viewpoint.

For standing waves, use tensioned elements with different amplitudes and phases so their curves align into the word.

For bending, use loaded structural beams whose deflection and depth visually form the typography.

For buckling, compress vertical structural elements until their controlled deformation reconnects into readable letterforms.

For shear, shift layered architectural sections laterally so fragmented type aligns from the intended camera angle.

The physical mechanism should be easy to understand at first glance. Keep gravity, tension, load, deformation, perspective and occlusion believable.

Use large geometric forms, strong color contrast and a clean contemporary architectural setting. From another viewpoint or after removing the force, the word should begin to break apart.

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

植物、花卉、动物与其他景物根据真实形态适度概括，使用饱满、均匀的平面设色与少量精细墨线。如有传统建筑，采用规整青绿瓦片、优雅飞檐、暖白墙面与朱红木结构。整体精致、干净、哑光，保留轻微纸本质感。

【构图与空间】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成。通过大面积色块、自然曲线、局部包围和暖米白留白组织画面，形成清晰的视觉重心与空间层次。

根据诗词灵活变化构图，突出最有代表性的意象与视觉关系。主体精描，辅助元素概括，地面与水面尽量简洁，只用少量细线和不规则墨色阴影表现空间，避免无关元素堆砌。

【东方配色】

采用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、赭红、橙金、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。以一种主色形成视觉重量，一种对比色突出核心意象，搭配墨色线条与干净留白。

色彩饱满、连续、均匀，具有鲜明的冷暖或明度对比。保持完整的大色面，不使用杂乱渐变、厚重纹理和过度做旧效果。

【中文海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边的深色区域，融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体。

在适当留白处加入小型纵排原诗句、准确的作者署名及少量朱红印章。文字清晰，层级分明，具有成熟的文化海报设计感。

【最终质量】

远看具有鲜明完整的大色块与优美构图，近看拥有精致细腻的工笔线条。保持建筑精描、植物概括、背景留白的视觉层级。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立叶片、复杂背景、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张诗意鲜明、配色惊艳、画面精致且具有统一系列美学的新中式古诗词艺术海报。

【对应关系】：裂缝 / 型腔 / 凹槽 / 火 / 液体 / 其他____

【辅助色】：____

生成一张具有强材质表现和成熟文化展览气质的「工艺转化型中轴夹景」海报。

画面核心不是左右摆两个物件，而是让“材料如何发生变化”直接成为构图。

左侧表现【初始状态】，右侧表现【完成状态】，中央则是最关键的工艺发生区域，例如修复裂缝、铸造型腔、镶嵌位置、窑火、液态材料或其他真实转化过程。

必须让观众即使不看说明文字，也能理解：

原始材料  → 工艺发生  → 完成状态

左右之间需要存在真实内容关系。例如裂开的两片器物能重新拼合，陶范负纹能对应铸件凸纹，凹槽能与贝片形状对应，生坯和成器必须是同一器型。

中央中轴不是普通色带，而要是真正发生“变化”的位置。可以加入 2–3 条非常克制的对应线或过程标记，但不能做成工艺流程 PPT。

材质表现必须真实：陶土、瓷釉、金属、漆面、贝片、木材等都要具有明确且稳定的表面逻辑。不要用噪点、斑驳和严重做旧代替材质细节。

Typography 要跟工艺逻辑发生关系，可以跨越不同材料、分布在前后状态、围绕中央变化轴或与主体轻微穿插。避免每张都使用固定四字纵排或中央巨大单字。

可加入一个小型研究节点，例如 PROCESS、SECTION、MATERIAL STUDY 或 3–4 个极简过程阶段，总面积控制在 6% 左右。

第一眼看到材料反差，二眼看到中央发生的变化，第三眼理解左右为什么属于同一个工艺过程。

避免：左右内容无关、过程关系不成立、材质像塑料、随机裂纹、过度火焰、复杂工具教学、技术参数过多、机械三栏排版、PPT 信息框、过度做旧和低完成度 AI 感。

FORMAT: wide landscape, 16:9
Create a compact conceptual typographic artwork displaying the subject in uppercase. Combine expressive custom lettering with ONE subject-specific visual motif, forming a single unified graphic silhouette on warm ivory.
DESIGN FOUNDATION — KEEP FIXED
Make the word the dominant graphic structure, spanning almost the entire artwork.
Draw tall, tightly fitted, high-contrast uppercase display-serif letters with exaggerated proportions: broad strokes, narrow openings, concave sides, sharp flared terminals, and stretched curves.
Shape the word as a whole. Vary letter widths and heights, subtly bending the top and bottom contours to fit the surrounding motif. Keep spelling and readability intact.
Render the letters as flat, solid, opaque shapes with crisp edges. Choose black, ivory, or white according to contrast. Keep letter faces untextured.
CONCEPT INFERENCE — CHANGE WITH THE SUBJECT
Identify the subject’s central visual quality. Translate it into ONE coherent motif and ONE organizing behavior, such as repetition, flowing expansion, compression, branching, or gradual transformation.
Build the entire image by developing that motif. Choose it for its expressive shape and relationship to the subject.
Express meaning through contour, rhythm, scale, spacing, and color. Do not assemble a collection of topical objects.
INTEGRATION
Fuse the motif with the word’s outer silhouette. Let it emerge from selected letter edges, extend above or below the lettering, and define meaningful white openings.
When a human profile is appropriate, simplify it into an elegant silhouette. Let it share a boundary with the word or motif. Avoid realistic portrait detail.
Keep most letter faces unobstructed. The motif should create a deliberate outer contour and a few strong internal relationships.
STYLE CALIBRATION
For HUMANITY:
Use a sequence of overlapping human profile silhouettes, with varied contours and a progression from black through medium gray to pale gray. Arrange them rhythmically across the upper portion of the word. Integrate dark profiles into the outer ends of the composition. Keep the lettering black and the treatment restrained, predominantly flat, and monochrome.
For CREATIVITY:
Use one continuous system of flowing, curled, vividly colored ribbons resembling sculpted liquid pigment. Form sweeping crests, spiral tips, and fine internal grooves in cyan, deep blue, magenta, orange, and yellow. Integrate a simplified profile into the left boundary. Place large white lettering across the darker central region. Confine smooth shading and highlights to the colored curls.
For other subjects:
Infer an equally economical motif and treatment. Preserve the same custom typography, unified silhouette, clean background, and limited visual vocabulary. Do not automatically repeat faces or colorful ribbons.
DETAIL AND DEPTH
Use clean silhouette edges and broad readable shapes. Concentrate fine detail inside the chosen motif.
Any shading should describe the motif’s local curvature. Keep the overall work a graphic illustration without a camera perspective, staged environment, or physical pedestal.
EXCLUSIONS
No miniature worlds, buildings, landscapes, crowds, realistic heads, floating symbolic objects, prop collections, or scenes inside letters.
No stone lettering, metallic lettering, beveled text, extruded letter blocks, cast shadows, distressed surfaces, or cinematic lighting.
COMPOSITION
Center the complete artwork with clear ivory margins. Keep its outer shape compact and intentional.
At thumbnail size, the viewer should immediately perceive the word and one visual idea. Remove anything that competes with those two readings.
Output one finished artwork containing only the subject word.

Create a contemporary material typography poster where the main word is physically generated by the transformation of the material itself.

Do not simply print or place the word onto the surface.

The typography should emerge through a real material process such as peeling, pneumatic expansion, erosion, cracking, splitting, melting, compression or another believable transformation.

The main title should occupy roughly 40–60% of the composition and remain bold, simple and highly readable at thumbnail size.

Use large-scale material changes rather than many small decorative details.

For peeling, let the outer surface physically lift, curl and separate to reveal a contrasting layer underneath, with the exposed areas forming the typography.

For swelling, let internal pressure push a continuous membrane outward so its inflated volumes and pressure valleys create the word.

For erosion, remove the outer material through wind, water or weathering so a contrasting inner layer is gradually revealed as readable type.

For cracking, let large fractures, broken edges and displaced surface pieces expose a contrasting internal material that forms the word.

The transformation should remain physically believable. Show realistic material thickness, tension, depth, shadows, exposed layers, deformation and surface behavior.

Keep the word integrated into one continuous material system. Avoid making each letter a separate 3D object.

Use one dominant material color, one strong contrasting revealed color, and a restrained architectural or natural environment.

The first visual impression should come from large color fields and a clear oversized word. The second impression should reveal how the material transformation actually creates the typography.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference. Their pose should feel natural and secondary to the installation.

Add only minimal editorial information such as project name, study title, location, date and one short conceptual line.

Overall style: material transformation, experimental typography, contemporary installation art, spatial graphic design, architectural photography, editorial poster, strong physicality, clear hierarchy and stop-scroll visual impact.

FORMAT: wide landscape, 16:9
Create a compact conceptual typographic artwork displaying the subject in uppercase. Combine expressive custom lettering with ONE subject-specific visual motif, forming a single unified graphic silhouette on warm ivory.
DESIGN FOUNDATION — KEEP FIXED
Make the word the dominant graphic structure, spanning almost the entire artwork.
Draw tall, tightly fitted, high-contrast uppercase display-serif letters with exaggerated proportions: broad strokes, narrow openings, concave sides, sharp flared terminals, and stretched curves.
Shape the word as a whole. Vary letter widths and heights, subtly bending the top and bottom contours to fit the surrounding motif. Keep spelling and readability intact.
Render the letters as flat, solid, opaque shapes with crisp edges. Choose black, ivory, or white according to contrast. Keep letter faces untextured.
CONCEPT INFERENCE — CHANGE WITH THE SUBJECT
Identify the subject’s central visual quality. Translate it into ONE coherent motif and ONE organizing behavior, such as repetition, flowing expansion, compression, branching, or gradual transformation.
Build the entire image by developing that motif. Choose it for its expressive shape and relationship to the subject.
Express meaning through contour, rhythm, scale, spacing, and color. Do not assemble a collection of topical objects.
INTEGRATION
Fuse the motif with the word’s outer silhouette. Let it emerge from selected letter edges, extend above or below the lettering, and define meaningful white openings.
When a human profile is appropriate, simplify it into an elegant silhouette. Let it share a boundary with the word or motif. Avoid realistic portrait detail.
Keep most letter faces unobstructed. The motif should create a deliberate outer contour and a few strong internal relationships.
STYLE CALIBRATION
For HUMANITY:
Use a sequence of overlapping human profile silhouettes, with varied contours and a progression from black through medium gray to pale gray. Arrange them rhythmically across the upper portion of the word. Integrate dark profiles into the outer ends of the composition. Keep the lettering black and the treatment restrained, predominantly flat, and monochrome.
For CREATIVITY:
Use one continuous system of flowing, curled, vividly colored ribbons resembling sculpted liquid pigment. Form sweeping crests, spiral tips, and fine internal grooves in cyan, deep blue, magenta, orange, and yellow. Integrate a simplified profile into the left boundary. Place large white lettering across the darker central region. Confine smooth shading and highlights to the colored curls.
For other subjects:
Infer an equally economical motif and treatment. Preserve the same custom typography, unified silhouette, clean background, and limited visual vocabulary. Do not automatically repeat faces or colorful ribbons.
DETAIL AND DEPTH
Use clean silhouette edges and broad readable shapes. Concentrate fine detail inside the chosen motif.
Any shading should describe the motif’s local curvature. Keep the overall work a graphic illustration without a camera perspective, staged environment, or physical pedestal.
EXCLUSIONS
No miniature worlds, buildings, landscapes, crowds, realistic heads, floating symbolic objects, prop collections, or scenes inside letters.
No stone lettering, metallic lettering, beveled text, extruded letter blocks, cast shadows, distressed surfaces, or cinematic lighting.
COMPOSITION
Center the complete artwork with clear ivory margins. Keep its outer shape compact and intentional.
At thumbnail size, the viewer should immediately perceive the word and one visual idea. Remove anything that competes with those two readings.
Output one finished artwork containing only the subject word.

不要只是给人物背景添加自然特效，而要先理解这一自然现象真实的运动规律，再让它直接组织人物、空间、线条与视觉动势。

例如：

声音可以用开放式回旋、波动与远近变化形成环绕结构；

人物必须真正进入这一运动结构，而不是简单站在特效前方。自然现象可以从人物前后穿过、绕行、遮挡、切分或改变空间，使人物与现象共同成为构图主体。

暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸背景，干净细腻的纸张纹理与轻微哑光印刷颗粒；真实自然的人物摄影质感；现代高对比中文 Typography + 优雅 Serif 英文标题 + 少量 Grotesk / Monospace 微信息；低饱和但完整的主题色，并保留极少量朱砂红作为系列视觉节点。

所有辅助文字必须围绕当前主题，可加入自然观察、方向、距离、时间、流速、光线等少量信息，不要使用无意义的模板文字、Series No.、Visual Study、Composition 等标签。

重点保证自然形态连续、流畅、干净：

水流与声场线条完整顺滑；
透明织物柔软、轻盈、连续，不出现块状斑驳和断裂；
光影边缘自然、有空间层次；
人物皮肤真实，不油亮、不塑料，不出现 CGI 感。

最终让观众第一眼看到完整人物海报，第二眼意识到：画面的构图并不是人为添加的装饰，而是由这股自然力量自己的运动规律生成。

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster that transforms the selected abstract concept into a monumental surreal spatial environment.

Do not simply design a building and place typography over it. The architecture itself must be generated from the logic of the concept.

Translate the theme into one clear spatial metaphor. Transit can become disconnected suspended platforms and passages. Time can become arcs, sunlight, long shadows and observation structures. Sound can become acoustic ribs, suspended panels and reverberation spaces. Memory can become fragmented rooms, doors, corridors and traces of human presence. For other themes, invent an equally direct architectural metaphor rather than reusing these examples mechanically.

Choose one dominant architectural gesture and build the entire composition around it. Avoid combining too many structural ideas. The image should have one immediately recognizable spatial identity even at small thumbnail size.

Integrate the main typography physically into the architecture. Large words, numbers or data should exist on different walls, platforms, curved surfaces, rooms or structural elements, following real perspective, scale, cropping, depth and occlusion. Typography may stretch across multiple spatial planes or only become readable from the chosen camera viewpoint. Never treat the main text as a flat graphic overlay.

Use the main typography as the visual hook. It should be simple enough to read quickly but surprising enough to make the viewer notice how it interacts with the space.

Add only a limited amount of secondary editorial information related to the theme, such as functional labels, measurements, timestamps, room information, observation data or short conceptual phrases. Keep many large surfaces completely blank so the design does not become a wall of text.

Populate the architecture with approximately 7 to 12 tiny adult human figures. Their poses should be natural and connected to the theme: waiting, walking, observing, listening, sitting, arriving or leaving. Keep people visually small so they establish scale, distance and emotional atmosphere rather than becoming portrait subjects.

Use large differences in architectural scale. Combine one or two monumental foreground structures with medium depth elements and several extremely small distant forms. Preserve clear foreground, middle ground and background separation.

Create strong but believable light and shadow. Let light participate in the concept whenever relevant: long shadows for time, isolated warm rooms for memory, controlled pools of light for sound, or directional daylight for transit. Avoid decorative cinematic effects that do not serve the spatial idea.

Use a restrained palette of ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated atmospheric tones. Introduce only one muted accent color on a small percentage of the architecture so each variation develops its own identity while remaining part of the same series.

Use matte concrete, stone, glass or paper like architectural surfaces with subtle grain, graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Keep the final image closer to a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster or experimental editorial print than a glossy CGI render.

Maintain strong asymmetry, deliberate negative space and controlled information density. Avoid conventional presentation boards, regular grids and perfectly balanced layouts. The composition should feel carefully designed but never mechanically templated.

The final result should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and slightly melancholic, with typography, architecture, tiny humans, light and spatial depth operating as one coherent visual system.

不要只是给人物背景添加自然特效，而要先理解这一自然现象真实的运动规律，再让它直接组织人物、空间、线条与视觉动势。

例如：
潮水可以用层层推进的曲线重新划分人物与空间边界；
声音可以用开放式回旋、波动与远近变化形成环绕结构；
风可以借助连续柔顺的织物、发丝或轻质材料显出流向；
光可以通过遮挡、缝隙、明暗切面与投影重新切割空间。

人物必须真正进入这一运动结构，而不是简单站在特效前方。自然现象可以从人物前后穿过、绕行、遮挡、切分或改变空间，使人物与现象共同成为构图主体。

统一视觉风格：

暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸背景，干净细腻的纸张纹理与轻微哑光印刷颗粒；真实自然的人物摄影质感；现代高对比中文 Typography + 优雅 Serif 英文标题 + 少量 Grotesk / Monospace 微信息；低饱和但完整的主题色，并保留极少量朱砂红作为系列视觉节点。

版面保持中高信息密度，但至少保留约 20% 有效留白。标题、人物与自然运动轨迹形成明确的视觉层级，整体具有 Contemporary Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster、文化展览视觉的高级感。

所有辅助文字必须围绕当前主题，可加入自然观察、方向、距离、时间、流速、光线等少量信息，不要使用无意义的模板文字、Series No.、Visual Study、Composition 等标签。

重点保证自然形态连续、流畅、干净：

水流与声场线条完整顺滑；
透明织物柔软、轻盈、连续，不出现块状斑驳和断裂；
光影边缘自然、有空间层次；
人物皮肤真实，不油亮、不塑料，不出现 CGI 感。

最终让观众第一眼看到完整人物海报，第二眼意识到：画面的构图并不是人为添加的装饰，而是由这股自然力量自己的运动规律生成。

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「竖三栏 / 左中右构图」。

重点不是把三个内容分别塞进三个栏，而是先用不等宽三栏建立清晰秩序，再通过主体、图像、线条、空间或无形视觉元素突破栏线，让三个区域重新形成一个完整画面。

可根据主题灵活使用以下方式：

图像越栏：传统绘画、花枝、鸟羽、植物或其他图像主体主要位于一至两个栏位，但局部必须主动突破边界，与其他色栏和 Typography 产生穿插关系。

主体偏置：大型文物、雕塑或人物明显压在其中一侧，另一侧通过年代、材质、档案文字和研究图建立视觉重量。主体可以侵入相邻栏位，但不要机械居中。

现象跨栏：实体主体停留在一侧，让声音、光线、烟气、水纹、运动轨迹等无形元素成为真正连接三栏的视觉线索。线条需要有明确来源、方向和传播逻辑，不要变成科技 UI 或随机装饰。

近中远空间：让三个栏分别承担近景、中景和远景，通过枝条、墙线、水路、石径、建筑轴线或视线连续跨栏，使三个区域看起来属于同一个空间，而不是三张照片拼贴。

三栏比例不要平均，根据主题使用例如 24/30/46、28/22/50、38/34/28 等不同关系。每一栏可以拥有不同背景色、信息密度和视觉重量，但整体必须平衡。

Typography 根据画面内容重新设计。可以使用横向跨栏标题、中等尺度标题、局部反色、图像压字、文字被主体轻微遮挡等方式。不要每张都使用超大单字，也不要固定使用四字纵排或“两字横排 + 两字竖排”。

信息密度参考成熟博物馆海报、艺术图录和 Editorial Design。可加入英文副标题、材质、年代、结构、日期、场馆、策展短句以及少量研究内容。

研究信息应与主题直接相关，例如：

文物测绘、纹样放大、材质档案、声学传播、近中远关系、建筑剖面或空间视线。

面积保持克制，作为第二层阅读内容，不要抢主视觉，也不要做成百科或 PPT。

核心原则：三栏负责建立秩序，跨栏元素负责打破边界，主体负责视觉重量，信息负责完成作品内容。

提示词：

生成一张 9:16 竖版高质量人物艺术海报，将一种“难以直接看见的自然现象或无形力量”转化成空间变化，让它直接参与构图。

主题：[热 / 雾 / 尘 / 磁 / 其他无形现象]
人物：[人物性别、年龄、服装、姿态]
主标题：[中文标题]
英文标题：[英文标题]
主色：[主色系]
空间变化：[折射 / 消隐 / 显现 / 偏转 / 扭曲 / 聚散等]

不要只是给人物加特效，而要表现这种无形现象如何真正改变周围空间：

热，可以通过空气折射、边缘轻微错位与背景弯曲，让空间产生波动；

雾，可以通过连续、柔和、半透明的层次逐渐抹去人物与环境边界；

尘，可以借助光束显现空气中原本不可见的细小颗粒，并产生自然悬浮与漂移；

磁，可以通过连续线条的弯曲、疏密变化与微粒排列，让看不见的力场显现方向。

人物必须真正处在这种空间变化之中，前景、人物、中景和背景要产生明确关系，不要变成“人物 + 背景特效”的简单叠加。

整体延续 Contemporary Asian Editorial Design / Museum Poster 气质：

暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸背景，细腻纸张纹理与轻微哑光印刷颗粒；真实自然的人物摄影质感；现代高对比中文 Typography + 优雅 Serif 英文标题 + 少量 Grotesk / Monospace 微信息；低饱和主题色，并用极少朱砂红作为系列视觉节点。

版面保持中高信息密度，同时保留约 20%–25% 有效留白。标题、人物与空间变化形成清楚的视觉层级。

所有辅助文字都围绕当前主题，可加入方向、距离、温度、光线、空气、边界等少量观察信息，不使用 Series No.、Visual Study、Composition 等模板化文字。

重点保证：

空气折射自然，不做夸张液化变形；
雾气连续、柔和、通透，不出现块状灰斑和脏污；
微尘细小、稀疏，只在光中被看见，不做闪粉或满屏颗粒；
磁力线连续顺滑，不做科技 HUD、霓虹能量线或科幻 UI；
人物皮肤真实自然，不过度磨皮、发光或油亮。

最终让观众第一眼看到完整人物海报，第二眼发现：真正组织画面的不是装饰，而是这些看不见的现象正在改变空间、边界与方向。

Create a 9:16 editorial poster based on a fan-shaped composition, with an emphasis on curved structures, flowing movement, and strong visual rhythm.

SUBJECT: [your subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [core idea or mood]
FAN LOGIC: [flowing ribbon / offset arcs / radial burst / motion arcs / mixed curved fan structure]
VISUAL MATERIALS: [photography / collage / textures / painting / architecture / people / objects]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–4 main colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [serif / grotesk / condensed sans / editorial mix]
BACKGROUND: [paper texture / flat tone / minimal backdrop]
TEXT DETAILS: [optional short meaningful phrases]

Use the fan-shaped composition as the main visual language, but do not limit it to straight wedges. The structure can bend, arc, curve, flow, expand, compress, or rotate depending on the concept.

Prioritize graceful visual movement. Let the composition guide the eye through the poster with ribbons, arcs, layered curved sections, or a single radial burst used in a more expressive way.

The shape should help express the idea:

* a flowing ribbon can suggest wind, motion, transition, or invisible force
* offset arcs can suggest observation, rhythm, memory, or layered perception
* a radial burst can suggest sound, signal, speed, or urban energy
* motion arcs can suggest body movement, choreography, or time unfolding

Build a strong large silhouette first, then fill it with controlled visual variety. Mix image sections, pure color areas, negative space, and small editorial details so the poster feels designed rather than template-based.

Allow some elements to break across the fan boundaries when useful. Curves should feel intentional and elegant, not decorative for their own sake.

Typography should feel integrated into the composition. Use one clear title, a short supporting line, and a small amount of editorial text. Keep the copy meaningful and concise.

The final poster should feel like an art-forward editorial collage: visually striking from a distance, but richer and more layered up close.

4 images: 1:1, do this for 4 famous scientists: WITH topic_identity AS (

layout_candidates AS (

根据古诗词创作一张具有教科书级插画质感的新中式细线设色艺术海报，将诗中的自然景物、动态关系与光影意境转化为完整、优美的东方视觉作品。

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描相结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

飞鸟、垂柳、梅枝等主体保留各自真实合理的形态，使用完整的平面设色与少量精细长线表现结构。建筑如有出现，采用规整青绿瓦片、优雅飞檐与简洁墙面。整体色彩饱满均匀、哑光干净，保留轻微纸本质感。

【构图与视觉动势】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成，根据诗意灵活调整视角。

重点提取诗词中的方向、曲线与空间关系，例如白鹤展翅向上、柳枝随风垂落、夕照斜入密林、梅枝横斜与水中疏影呼应。

通过大面积色块、斜向引导、自然曲线和暖米白留白形成明确的视觉焦点。动势自然流畅，主体突出，辅助景物概括，避免元素堆砌和复杂背景。

【东方配色与光影】

使用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、赭金、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。

以一种主色建立视觉重量，另一种对比色突出核心意象。强调冷暖关系、明度层次与完整的大色面，保留干净的留白。

阳光、树影与水中倒影使用克制的平面设色和少量细线表达，避免摄影式体积光、复杂反射、强烈渐变和厚重阴影。

【中文海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边深色区域融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体。

在适当留白处加入精致的小型纵排原诗句、准确的朝代与作者署名，以及一至两枚朱红印章。文字清晰，疏密有序，与画面动势自然协调。

【最终质量】

保持大形鲜明、长线流畅、色彩完整、局部精描与背景留白的视觉层级。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立叶片、复杂羽毛、杂乱纹理、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张画风统一、构图有张力、色彩高级、诗意鲜明的新中式古诗词艺术海报。远看具有强烈的视觉识别度，近看拥有精致细腻的工笔线条与东方装饰美感。

提示词：

【主题】：如石隙 / 冰隙 / 林隙 / 土隙

【左侧巨大材质】：
【右侧巨大材质】：
【中央裂隙氛围】：
【底部微小生命元素】：
【主色调】：
【辅助文案】：
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一张东方自然主义 Editorial Design 海报，采用「夹缝构图 / Interval Composition」。

画面左右分别由两个尺度巨大的自然材质实体进入画幅，并被画面边缘裁切。两侧主体向中央挤压，在中间形成一条从顶部贯穿到底部的狭窄纵向负空间。中央裂隙是整张海报真正的视觉主角。

裂隙不要完全笔直，可以呈缓慢自然的 S 型收放关系：顶部略宽，中部收紧，下部再次打开。内部保持明亮、干净、有空气感，不填入复杂风景。左右巨大材质使用【左侧巨大材质】与【右侧巨大材质】，重点表现真实的大尺度结构、连续纹理和自然表面质感。不要让微小纹理压过整体构图。

始终遵循：先看到巨大形体，再看到材质细节。

两侧主体可以形成轻微差异，例如一侧更深、更重、更粗粝，另一侧更浅、更透光或更柔和，避免完全镜像。在中央裂隙底部加入一个比例极小的【底部微小生命元素】，例如新芽、蕨叶、苔藓、种子或细草。生命元素只占画面的极小面积，通过“大尺度自然实体”与“微小生命”形成明显比例反差，让画面产生叙事感。

使用大型英文 Serif Typography：【英文标题】标题横跨左右材质与中央裂隙。

文字根据背景明暗自然切换深浅颜色：深色材质区域使用暖米白文字，亮色裂隙区域使用深墨灰文字。允许材质边缘轻微遮挡部分字母，形成清楚的二维编辑层级，但保持整体可读。中央裂隙内部加入较小的纵向中文标题【主题】。中文使用纤细、克制、具有东方骨架的现代宋体或文化出版字体，不使用巨大毛笔书法。

加入极少量辅助文案【辅助文案】，使用小字号散布在材质边缘或留白区域，不形成普通信息框，不加入无意义英文。整体配色使用【主色调】，保持低饱和、自然、哑光和克制。画面应具有高级艺术展览海报、独立出版物、自然材料研究与 Editorial Design 气质。

整体视觉公式：左右巨大实体

* 中央纵向负空间
* 底部微小生命
* 跨层大型 Typography
* 大面积低信息区域

最终效果必须让人在缩略图状态下依然首先看到“两侧巨大形体夹出一道明亮裂隙”，近看后才发现材质纹理、生命细节与小型文字。

背景使用温润、干净的暖象牙白手工纸，保留极轻天然纤维和细腻纸浆纹理。画面主动保留约 45%–60% 的大面积留白，让空白本身成为构图的一部分，不使用大量山水、植物、建筑或装饰元素填满背景。

使用【核心大色域】作为画面的第一视觉主体。大色域占据约 25%–40% 的画面，根据【海报主题】可以表现为幕布、嵌套层、长轴、薄纸、纸浆、器物结构或其他抽象大形，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域必须拥有真实而高级的手工纸材料感，包括天然长短纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、大尺度自然色差、轻微压痕、自然毛边与哑光表面。材质丰富但保持干净、完整，不做脏旧、黄斑、严重破损、随机斑驳、强噪点或廉价复古效果。

整体主色使用【主色调】，颜色数量保持克制。低饱和但色面必须完整、有浓度，不要把“东方感”理解成褪色、灰蒙或陈旧。可以设置一枚极小朱砂红印记或一个极小暖色节点作为点睛，总面积控制在画面 1%–2%。

在大色域附近加入一个尺度非常小但叙事完整的【微型文化场景】。人物、桌面、工具和器物整体只占画面约 3%–5%，让观者远看先看到大形和留白，靠近后才发现人物正在完成【核心动作】。

所有人物必须采用二维纸本淡彩插画语言，与整张海报使用同一种纸、同一套颜料和同一个画师般的视觉语言。人物面部只用少量克制线点概括五官，不刻画真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、眼球高光或摄影式面部阴影。

人物身体只使用轻微二维明暗表达基础体积，服装主要使用完整、低饱和、哑光的平面色块，仅加入少量连续自然的线性衣褶。人物脚下只保留非常淡的贴纸接触阴影。

禁止摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 体积感、塑料皮肤、电影光影、强轮廓光、摄影景深和强投影。人物必须像直接画在纸上的东方编辑插画。

根据主题加入少量【文化器物】，器物真正参与人物动作，不做整齐商品陈列，不堆满工作台。器物、人物与场景均保持纸本淡彩和轻工笔质感。

在微型场景和巨大主视觉之间建立一个清楚但克制的“尺度连接”。可以根据主题使用一根琴弦、操偶杆、纤维、漆线、纸边、工具轨迹或其他真实来源的细线，将微型手工行为视觉上连接到巨大色域。

连接元素必须有真实起点、完整走势和明确终点，不得漂浮、断裂或作为无意义装饰。

主标题【主标题】放在大面积留白区域，使用纤细、端正、具有现代东方文化机构气质的中文宋体或明朝体。标题保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，让文字成为第二视觉层级。

标题上方可加入极小英文活动类别，标题下方加入一行简短中文副题。日期、地点与活动信息使用更小字号集中排布在边缘留白区，形成真实文化海报的信息层级。

整体风格融合手工纸拼贴、水彩或矿物颜料肌理、二维纸本淡彩插画、微型文化叙事与现代东方编辑设计。

生成一张具有高级东方文化展览气质的 Editorial Poster。

先确定一个绝对视觉核心，再让器物、文字、色场、山水、纹样、光影或空间关系共同把视线推向这个核心。

不要简单把主体放在画面中央，而要根据内容选择真正有意义的“聚合力量”：

- 同心结构：利用圆形器物、环形文字、纹样与负空间逐层向中心收束；
- 叙事回流：让山势、江流、云雾、人物或故事中的运动方向形成连续视觉路径，最终回到主体；
- Typography 压核：让大字、色块和留白从不同方向向主体施压，文字本身参与构图，而不是贴在旁边；
- 光域聚焦：通过明暗递减、光线范围和空间层次，让最亮或最重要的一点自然成为视觉中心。

器物必须有真实的材质、纹理、包浆、磨损与重量感，同时与背景视觉语言自然融合，不要像商品图直接贴在海报上。

Typography 必须服务作品内容。标题、诗句、短文和展览信息都应与器物及文化主题本身有关，不出现“视觉聚核”“案例”“设计研究”等模板占位文字。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要颜色，可参考朱砂、墨黑、青玉、赭石、青铜绿、琥珀金、宣纸白等东方色系，通过强弱、冷暖和明暗建立层级。

保留足够负空间，让画面丰富但不杂乱。第一眼看到视觉核心，第二眼感受到周围元素如何向核心聚合，第三眼再阅读标题与文化信息。

整体要求：
东方器物 × 当代 Editorial Design × Museum Poster
有文化内容、有设计巧思、有完整作品感，不做模板化海报。

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 experimental character poster using a close or waist-up portrait with expressive body language.

Keep most of the portrait in high-contrast black and white, then add a clear halftone screen-print effect. Use finer dots on the face and denser dots in the hair, clothing and shadows, so it feels like a printed zine rather than simple photo grain.

Add one color scan window through an important part of the portrait. It can run vertically across the eye, face and hand, horizontally through the eyes and gesture, or extend from the face down into the collar and body.

Inside this window, return to clean high-resolution photography with realistic cool-neutral skin, blue-grey shadows and natural lip tones. Keep it crisp and free of halftone texture so the contrast between “printed portrait” and “real detail” feels obvious.

Use oversized condensed typography as part of the composition rather than placing a title in empty space. Let the letters crop off the canvas, overlap the body, pass behind the subject or cut across the scan window.

Keep the palette restrained: black, white and cool grey as the base, then one cool blue and one muted red / burgundy as accents.

Only add a few small identity-style labels such as “IDENTITY TRACE”, “SUBJECT ACTIVE”, “GESTURE READ” or “FEATURE ACTIVE”. A few thin lines, circles and open corner marks are enough.

The final image should feel like a mix of youth-culture poster, printed zine, character dossier and experimental magazine editorial.

Avoid warm yellow grading, multiple random scan windows, floating facial features, heavy glitch effects, dense UI graphics, long paragraphs, numbering, Vol./Issue labels, sparkle symbols, logos or watermarks.

I asked GPT to show me 4 empires. Another fun experiment. 

Do this for [Word/Concept]:
<instruction>
  1. The Semantic Inference Engine  
Input A is a Noun or Concept (e.g., Siege, Voyage, Harvest, Factory).
Deconstruct the concept into   3 Visual Metaphors  :
   The Architecture (The Stems):  Identify buildings or large structures that can replace the vertical strokes of the letters.
   (e.g., Siege -> Castle Towers. Voyage -> Ship Masts. Factory -> Smokestacks). 
   The Machinery (The Curves):  Identify tools, vehicles, or moving parts that can replace the curved or horizontal strokes of the letters.
   (e.g., Siege -> A Trebuchet/Catapult. Voyage -> Waves or Sails. Factory -> Gears). 
   The Action (The Motion Line):  Identify a dynamic element that sweeps across the word, connecting the letters or creating an arch.
   (e.g., Siege -> The arc of a thrown boulder. Voyage -> A flock of birds or a constellation). 
2. Container (The Canvas):
Goal: "Negative Space/Silhouette" Typography Design.

The Background: A pure, untextured White Canvas.
The Medium: Solid Black Ink. High contrast, no gradients, no grey tones (pure bitmap/threshold style).

3. The Letters :

The Baseline: The word (Input A) is written horizontally across the center. A unified baseline (e.g., water ripples, a fortress wall, a field) connects the bottom of all the letters.
The Letterforms: The letters are perfectly legible but constructed entirely from the "Metaphors" (Step 1).
Example ("SIEGE"): The 'I' is a watchtower. The 'E' is a castle wall profile. The 'G' is the wheel and arm of a catapult.
The Interaction: The objects within the letters interact with each other. For example, the catapult (G) is firing a rock over the tower (I) and the trail of the rock forms the top curve of the 'S'.

4. Visual Syntax (The Style):

Style: Woodcut Print / Rough Ink Brush. The edges of the black shapes are slightly textured, rough, and jagged, simulating a hand-drawn brush pen or a linocut print.
Silhouettes: Add tiny, pure black silhouettes of humans or animals interacting with the giant letter-structures (e.g., tiny archers standing on the crossbar of the 'E', or tiny sailors on the deck) to provide an immense sense of scale.

Output: ONE image, Horizontal Aspect Ratio (16:9), 2D Vector/Illustration, "Illustrated Typography" aesthetic, Monochromatic Black on White.
</instruction>

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 editorial collage poster built around a fan-shaped composition where the geometry directly expresses the concept.

SUBJECT: [your theme / subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [what the poster should communicate]
FAN STRUCTURE: [layered curved fan / concentric arcs / large color wedges / radial burst / custom variation]
VISUAL CONTENT: [people / places / events / objects / moments / textures]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–5 dominant colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [editorial serif / grotesk / condensed sans / mixed system]
BACKGROUND: [paper tone / flat color / minimal backdrop]
TEXT DETAILS: [short meaningful phrases / optional event or editorial information]

Choose the fan structure according to the meaning of the poster rather than using it as decoration.

For example:

* layered curved fans can suggest distance, travel, space, or unfolding experience
* concentric arcs can suggest emotion, perception, memory, or inner states
* large color wedges can organize communities, events, contrasting themes, or parallel worlds
* sharp radial cuts can suggest time, speed, simultaneous moments, or explosive energy

Build one clear large-scale composition first. From a distance, the fan geometry should be immediately readable and visually striking; up close, the viewer should discover richer photography, people, environments, textures, and narrative details.

Do not make every section equal. Vary the width, scale, density, and direction of the fan areas. Mix image-heavy sections with pure color fields and negative space to create rhythm.

Photography should adapt to the geometry rather than sit inside rectangular frames. Use bold cropping, scale shifts, partial subjects, layered imagery, and a few controlled elements crossing the boundaries when useful.

Keep each major section visually coherent with its own dominant color or tonal identity. The overall palette should feel intentional, not randomly multicolored.

Typography should support the concept and composition. Use one strong title, a concise supporting line, and only the amount of editorial information the poster actually needs. Place text mainly in quieter areas so it does not compete with the most complex collage regions.

The finished image should feel like a complete art or editorial poster, not a fan-shaped photo template. The shape itself should help tell the story.

Keep one facial detail clearly recognizable—such as one eye, the glasses, or the nose bridge—while the rest of the portrait gradually shifts through blur, reflection, colored light, or motion. The blur must have a clear direction and visual cause, not look randomly out of focus.

4 directions:

1. SIGNAL CUT — a sharp eye crossed by a vivid light beam, while the hair and face stretch into horizontal motion trails.

2. FILTER STATE — a fashion portrait seen through translucent colored acrylic panels, with the glasses and eyes remaining crisp.

3. PASSING FRAME — a clear subject standing still while blurred figures move through the foreground and a soft reflection appears behind.

4. MINT STATIC — a quiet portrait dissolving into mint-colored haze, with one eye still visible inside the soft motion blur.

Use realistic skin, natural hair, believable fabric, cinematic lighting, subtle grain, strong negative space, and a restrained editorial layout.

生成一张 9:16 竖版明星应援 Editorial 海报。画面中央并排放置两个尺寸完全相同的狭长竖框：等宽、等高、比例一致，处于同一平面，没有近大远小、主副关系或透视缩放；两个竖框共同占据画面主要面积。

左侧竖框负责人物识别：放置【人物姓名】的写实近景或大半身肖像，保持真实摄影质感、自然皮肤纹理与清晰眼神。加入巨型裁切英文名、中文姓名、生日、人物身份及少量微型信息。文字与人物轮廓互相遮挡穿插，形成高级杂志排版。

右侧竖框负责叙事与情绪：外框尺寸与左侧完全一致，但将内部的横向人物摄影、场景和字体排版整体旋转 90°装入竖框。通过【代表性视觉概念】表现人物经历、气质或粉丝情绪，并清晰展示【英文主题】与【中文口号】。中文口号必须醒目可读，不能缩成装饰小字。

使用一条具有叙事作用的视觉元素贯穿两个竖框，并向背景延伸，例如运动轨迹、声波、光场、胶片帧或其他与人物相关的符号，让左右两侧形成完整联系。

生成一张东方自然主义 Editorial Design 海报，采用「夹缝构图 / Interval Composition」。

画面左右分别由两个尺度巨大的自然材质实体进入画幅，并被画面边缘裁切。两侧主体向中央挤压，在中间形成一条从顶部贯穿到底部的狭窄纵向负空间。中央裂隙是整张海报真正的视觉主角。

裂隙不要完全笔直，可以呈缓慢自然的 S 型收放关系：顶部略宽，中部收紧，下部再次打开。内部保持明亮、干净、有空气感，不填入复杂风景。左右巨大材质使用【左侧巨大材质】与【右侧巨大材质】，重点表现真实的大尺度结构、连续纹理和自然表面质感。不要让微小纹理压过整体构图。

始终遵循：先看到巨大形体，再看到材质细节。

两侧主体可以形成轻微差异，例如一侧更深、更重、更粗粝，另一侧更浅、更透光或更柔和，避免完全镜像。在中央裂隙底部加入一个比例极小的【底部微小生命元素】，例如新芽、蕨叶、苔藓、种子或细草。生命元素只占画面的极小面积，通过“大尺度自然实体”与“微小生命”形成明显比例反差，让画面产生叙事感。

使用大型英文 Serif Typography：【英文标题】标题横跨左右材质与中央裂隙。

文字根据背景明暗自然切换深浅颜色：深色材质区域使用暖米白文字，亮色裂隙区域使用深墨灰文字。允许材质边缘轻微遮挡部分字母，形成清楚的二维编辑层级，但保持整体可读。中央裂隙内部加入较小的纵向中文标题【主题】。中文使用纤细、克制、具有东方骨架的现代宋体或文化出版字体，不使用巨大毛笔书法。

加入极少量辅助文案【辅助文案】，使用小字号散布在材质边缘或留白区域，不形成普通信息框，不加入无意义英文。整体配色使用【主色调】，保持低饱和、自然、哑光和克制。画面应具有高级艺术展览海报、独立出版物、自然材料研究与 Editorial Design 气质。

整体视觉公式：左右巨大实体

* 中央纵向负空间
* 底部微小生命
* 跨层大型 Typography
* 大面积低信息区域

最终效果必须让人在缩略图状态下依然首先看到“两侧巨大形体夹出一道明亮裂隙”，近看后才发现材质纹理、生命细节与小型文字。

避免：普通风景摄影、旅游海报、主体塞满中央、复杂背景、满屏纹理、密集裂纹、大量植物、鲜艳颜色、强 HDR、CGI 材质、3D Typography、无意义英文和过度装饰。

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 vertical poster in a clean contemporary museum-like architectural space, with minimal editorial typography and a small human figure for scale. The style should feel like a high-end exhibition poster: pale stone or concrete surfaces, strong daylight, crisp shadows, refined composition, and a calm but striking atmosphere. Make the word itself become the installation, fully integrated into space. Add small English micro-copy in the corners like a design study poster, but do not add any copyright marks or page numbers.

1. PRESS
   Use a deformation concept. Show the word “IMPACT” stretched across a large white tensile membrane wall, with a giant red sphere pushing forward from behind the surface so the fabric bulges outward and distorts the typography. The letters should feel pulled, compressed, and tensioned by the pressure. The result should feel physical, dramatic, and instantly readable.

2. TWIST
   Use a torsion concept. Build the word “TWIST” as a row of tall vertical panels or columns that rotate along their central axis. Each element should carry blue and yellow graphic surfaces, and together they should reveal the full word through twisting alignment. The feeling should be bold, graphic, and highly sculptural.

3. FOLD
   Use a folded-plane concept. Build the word “FOLD” across a sequence of large hinged standing panels in a bright museum hall. Each panel should pivot at a slightly different angle, so the letters are split and reassembled across the folding surfaces. Use a blue, white, and red palette. The image should feel crisp, architectural, and strongly graphic.

4. BALANCE
   Use an equilibrium concept. Build the word “BALANCE” from suspended blue geometric letter components hanging from a black structural framework, with orange counterweights, rods, and pendulum-like elements. The composition should suggest weight, tension, and precise mechanical balance. The result should feel intelligent, physical, and visually clean.

  • 5 phases, ONE continuous body, transparency decay 0.82^(n-1)
  • Trajectory = cubic bezier, phase spacing COMPRESSES at peak force
  • Negative space EXPANDS post-impact (the exhale after the event)

Create a 9:16 vertical city poster using iconic landmarks from the same city.

Behind the architecture, place the city name in huge ultra-tall condensed sans-serif typography. The letters should occupy around 45–60% of the image, partially hidden behind the landmarks while remaining clearly readable.

Render the landmarks with realistic architectural photography, then add subtle vintage editorial print texture, fine grain, halftone and paper texture.

Add a small blurred foreground detail connected to the city, occupying only around 5–10% of the lower edge, to create depth and local atmosphere.

iconic landmarks + extreme low-angle perspective + radial convergence + giant city typography + limited colors + subtle foreground depth.

E₅  SINGLE‑POSTER FRAME   ONE poster; ¬right‑hand spec panel; ¬2:1; ¬split; cohesive composition.   ¬E₅ = panel/2:1/split. η   HONEST PRINT   registration, paper grain, ink behavior authentic to the chosen mechanics. FORBIDDEN = duplicate pick · collage · buried subject · missing/illegible info · lorem · flat digital · spec panel · 2:1 WORLDS=[...30...]; MECH=[...25...]  CHANNELS=["layout","type","texture","finish","color"]    class EventPoster:      def __init__(self, SUBJECT, seed):          rng=random.Random(seed)          self.w1,self.w2=rng.sample(WORLDS,2); self.m1,self.m2=rng.sample(MECH,2)   # distinct          self.fuse=self.reconcile()        def reconcile(self):                                    # E₁: channel‑wise dominance          master={c:max((self.m1,self.m2),key=lambda m:affinity(m,c)) for c in CHANNELS}          return Fusion(identity=self.w1, accent=self.w2, master=master,                        palette=derive(self.w1,self.w2), name=event_name(SUBJECT,self.w1))        def render(self):          info=infer_info(SUBJECT,self.fuse)                  # name,date,location,tagline,details (E₃)          return single_poster( icon=iconify(SUBJECT, self.fuse),          # E₂ dominant icon                                layers=mechanic_layers(self.fuse),          # E₄ authentic artifacts                                text=info, hierarchy=STRONG )        def verify(self, img, info):          assert one_value_per_channel(img,self.fuse),        "E₁: two posters fighting"          assert iconic_at_distance(img, SUBJECT) and dominant(SUBJECT,img), "E₂"          assert all_present(info,[name,date,location,tagline]) and 1<=len(details)<=3 \             and all(legible(t,img) for t in info) and not lorem(img), "E₃"          assert mechanic_artifacts(img,self.fuse.master),    "E₄: flat digital"          assert frames(img)==1 and not spec_panel(img) and not two_to_one(img), "E₅"    EventPoster(SUBJECT, seed).render()

it's the engine we talked about the other day. That chooses from a total of 200,000 styles. Essentially breaking down styles, layouts, font family... in multiple arrays and picking one from each

The total combination is just over 200k. There are multiple arrays, it picks a style from each and hybridizes. I have added a randomizer function to it that makes sure it doesn't default to anything, doesn't repeat. I ran it 5 times, each time 4 images, got 20 different styles. Will it repeat at some point? It's possible. However, I can link it to a database and completely randomize if I wanted to.

Create a high-end experimental architectural poster where typography becomes architecture itself.

Make “[WORD]” the main spatial structure, built from real architectural materials rather than placed over a photo or rendered as floating 3D text.

Use one construction logic:

Growth: letters grow into walls, ramps, corridors, façades, and structural forms.

Carved: letters are cut, recessed, folded, or opened directly into one continuous architectural surface through negative space, glass, shadow, and material changes.

The architecture itself should feel sculptural and visually striking, with strong massing, curves, voids, light, and refined material transitions. Use realistic perspective, material thickness, joints, reflections, and tiny human figures for scale.

structure → abstraction → deformation → dissolution

Keep the lines thin, gray-white, non-glowing, with one concentrated Line Event before they gradually fade into the black space.

Use a deep matte-black field with generous negative space. Keep colors restrained: graphite, concrete gray, metal silver, glass tones, plus a subtle warm-light or cool-blue accent.

Use minimal micro typography like an architectural research archive.

Only show:
“AETHER — SPATIAL STUDIES”
“[WORD]”
“[CONCEPT]”
“[MATERIALS]”
“2026”

Final result: sculptural, spatial, minimal, experimental, and highly designed.

Avoid floating 3D text, random decorative lines, cyberpunk effects, UI graphics, extra text, page numbers, logos, and watermarks.

提示词：

【古诗名句】：填写一句具有强画面感的诗句
【两字主题】：从诗句中提炼 2 个核心字
【核心构图】：竖线与圆 / 点与面 / 斜线与三角 / 横线与小点 / 其他
【视觉主体】：孤烟 / 落日 / 孤城 / 云帆 / 孤舟 / 人物等
【点缀色】：朱红 / 群青 / 墨蓝 / 暖金等
【浅压纹】：沙丘 / 山脉 / 风痕 / 水纹 / 雪地路径等
【地点与日期】：填写

生成一张 9:16 竖版东方诗意留白海报，将【古诗名句】中的空间关系提炼成【核心构图】，不要直接复刻完整古诗场景。

使用纯白或浅冷白高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留真实纸纤维、纸浆颗粒和细腻压痕。画面保持约 70% 的有效留白，让主体面积尽量克制，用少量元素形成明确视觉重心。

将【视觉主体】简化成清晰的线、点、圆、三角、色块或横向结构，通过比例、方向和位置关系表现诗句里的空间张力。主体不需要巨大，但缩略图中必须容易识别。

背景加入与诗句相关的低对比【浅压纹】，例如白色山脉、沙丘、风线、江面、雪痕或地貌结构。压纹要有一定可见度，但不能过重，主要依靠纸面高度、柔和侧光与细微阴影呈现，远看简洁，近看有细节。

使用【点缀色】建立单一而强烈的视觉锚点，例如一轮朱红落日、一座红色孤城、一张群青云帆或一点朱红浮漂。不要大面积铺色，让高饱和颜色与白色留白形成明显反差。

可加入极小人物、驼队、小舟等建立尺度关系，但数量必须少，避免复杂叙事。

所有风线、水线、烟线和地貌边缘都要连续、柔和、自然，避免大量断点、碎线和杂乱 AI 纹理。

中文主标题使用【两字主题】，采用现代宋体、明朝体或具有编辑感的中文衬线字体，可根据构图加入细线、轻微错位或方向呼应，但必须保证汉字完整、准确、清晰。同时加入小字号诗句、地点、日期和简短英文标题。

整体效果应像古诗空间意象、极简构图、纸张浅浮雕与现代 Editorial Design 的结合：远看有明确视觉张力，近看才能发现隐藏在留白里的山水、风雪与空间细节。

Prompt:

TITLE: [your word]  
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign]  
MATERIAL: [facade skin / elastic membrane / stone / plaster / earth / other]  
TRANSFORMATION: [peeling / swelling / erosion / cracking / other]  
HIDDEN LAYER: [color / material / none]  
ENVIRONMENT: [museum / outdoor plaza / desert / architecture / other]  
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]  
MAIN COLORS: [2–3 colors]  
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary material typography poster where the main word is physically generated by the transformation of the material itself.

Do not simply print or place the word onto the surface.

The typography should emerge through a real material process such as peeling, pneumatic expansion, erosion, cracking, splitting, melting, compression or another believable transformation.

The main title should occupy roughly 40–60% of the composition and remain bold, simple and highly readable at thumbnail size.

Use large-scale material changes rather than many small decorative details.

For peeling, let the outer surface physically lift, curl and separate to reveal a contrasting layer underneath, with the exposed areas forming the typography.

For swelling, let internal pressure push a continuous membrane outward so its inflated volumes and pressure valleys create the word.

For erosion, remove the outer material through wind, water or weathering so a contrasting inner layer is gradually revealed as readable type.

For cracking, let large fractures, broken edges and displaced surface pieces expose a contrasting internal material that forms the word.

The transformation should remain physically believable. Show realistic material thickness, tension, depth, shadows, exposed layers, deformation and surface behavior.

Keep the word integrated into one continuous material system. Avoid making each letter a separate 3D object.

Use one dominant material color, one strong contrasting revealed color, and a restrained architectural or natural environment.

The first visual impression should come from large color fields and a clear oversized word. The second impression should reveal how the material transformation actually creates the typography.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference. Their pose should feel natural and secondary to the installation.

Add only minimal editorial information such as project name, study title, location, date and one short conceptual line.

Overall style: material transformation, experimental typography, contemporary installation art, spatial graphic design, architectural photography, editorial poster, strong physicality, clear hierarchy and stop-scroll visual impact.

Avoid flat pasted text, ordinary 3D letters, random damage, excessive debris, weak material logic, tiny decorative details, neon sci-fi styling, cluttered environments, excessive filler copy, watermarks and numbering.

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「竖三栏 / 左中右构图」。

三栏不要平均分割，也不要做成三个独立信息框。根据主题灵活调整宽度，让每一栏承担不同视觉职责，再通过主体、文字、线条或材质主动跨越栏线，把三个区域重新连接成一个完整画面。

可根据内容选择不同方式：

人物跨栏：人物主要位于中栏，衣袖、裙摆或饰物进入左右栏，让左侧负责纹样与材质，右侧负责结构与档案信息。

同一主体三栏变化：让一件连续主体同时穿过三栏，在不同栏位呈现不同材质、阶段或状态，但轮廓必须连续，不能变成三个独立物体。

中栏主景：中央栏放置最强主视觉，例如山体、建筑或大型图像，左右栏承担标题、日期、材质、研究信息，并允许部分主体或云雾越栏。

器物跨栏：大型器物从一侧斜向或横向进入其他栏位，用主体本身打破竖向网格，让三栏只是排版秩序，而不是物理边界。

Typography 根据每张画面的结构重新设计，可使用超大单字、完整横排标题、跨栏标题、中等尺度标题或小型信息脊柱。不要固定使用四字纵排，也不要重复“两字横排 + 两字竖排”的模板。

信息密度要接近成熟博物馆海报、艺术图录和 Editorial Design：加入英文副标题、材质、结构、日期、场馆、策展短句和少量研究图，但集中在 2–3 个区域，不要平均铺满全画面。

可以加入小型结构线稿、材质研究、制作流程、剖面或纹样研究，但面积保持克制，只作为第二层阅读内容。

色彩使用 3–5 个主要颜色，以大面积纯净色域形成明显栏位关系。允许黑、骨白、朱红、钴蓝、深青、赭色等组合，但避免脏灰、严重做旧和复杂渐变。

整体要求：高清、清晰、干净、信息丰富但有秩序，主体比例准确，文字与细线锐利，具有成熟文化展览海报完成度。

避免：机械三等分、三个独立卡片、PPT 信息框、固定标题模板、主体过小、栏位完全割裂、随机小字、无意义装饰线、过度做旧、斑驳噪点和低完成度 AI 海报感。

Create a highly believable 9:16 vertical smartphone mirror selfie inside a private residential bathroom or bathroom-adjacent mirror area. The subject is a clearly adult young woman with a naturally slim, light build, standing almost front-facing toward the mirror but with a tiny lateral hip shift that creates a soft, unforced S-curve through the waist. This is not a fitness pose, fashion pose or deliberately seductive pose. She raises a light cream/beige smartphone directly in front of the center of her face; the back of the phone is visible, including a white circular magnetic-ring graphic and a realistic triple-camera module. The phone obscures almost the entire face, leaving at most tiny fragments of an ear, jawline or cheek around the edges. Do not reconstruct or reveal a clear full face. Her other hand rests vertically beside the phone and cheek as though she has only just finished adjusting her grip. Maintain correct mirror-reflection logic, show only one phone and two anatomically correct hands, and never show the phone screen.  She has very dark brown-black to natural black long hair with a near-center part. It is mostly straight but curves softly near the ends, and most of its weight falls over one side of the body. The hair should look naturally smooth rather than commercially perfect: a little volume, a few flyaways, small irregularities and soft brown-black reflections where the light catches individual strands.  She wears a loose white short-sleeve crew-neck cotton T-shirt. The lower hem has been casually lifted or rolled upward and has gathered into believable horizontal folds around the lower chest and upper abdomen. Her chest remains fully covered, while a broad continuous area of skin from the lower ribcage down to the low pajama waistband is exposed, including the abdomen, side waist, navel and upper hips. Keep the abdomen naturally flat and the waist visibly narrow but realistic—no extreme hourglass proportions, carved six-pack, bodybuilder definition or exaggerated body reshaping.  Her visible skin is fair to light with a neutral-warm beige-apricot undertone. Preserve faint pores, subtle tonal differences and the softness of real abdominal skin. It should look as though it would feel warm, smooth, softly elastic and slightly dry-matte to the touch, never waxy, plastic, heavily retouched or oily CGI skin. The hands and forearms are also visible, together with only tiny peripheral fragments of the neck, jaw or ear; the shoulders remain covered by the T-shirt, the chest stays covered, and the legs remain inside the pajama pants.  The pajama pants are loose and soft with a white base covered in scattered multicolored classic cartoon characters and playful abstract shapes in red, blue, yellow, green and black. The elastic waistband sits relatively low on the hips, and a thin red drawstring hangs from the center. Let the sleepwear fabric fall naturally with small vertical wrinkles; it must remain loose rather than turning into tight leggings. On the wrist holding the phone, include several stacked translucent or pearl-like beaded bracelets mixed with one finer chain bracelet.  Keep the environment recognizably domestic and imperfect. Behind her is a large dark reddish-brown wooden door with a heavy wood frame and two translucent frosted-glass panels. Metal hinges remain visible on the left side of the door. On the right is a vintage brass-colored handle with a small bundle of dark cord hanging near it. A warm-white tiled bathroom wall and a small portion of a white bathtub or ledge appear along the right edge, while a narrow mirror or wooden frame remains visible on the left. Allow tiny cropped traces of ordinary household clutter near the bottom rather than cleaning the scene into a luxury interior.  Build the lighting from physical sources rather than abstract cinematic glow. The main directional source behaves like daylight or a bright adjacent room positioned above and toward the subject's front-right side. It creates soft but clearly directional illumination across the central abdomen, part of the side waist and the forearms, while the opposite side of the waist falls gradually into shadow. Natural shadows remain beneath the lower ribs, inside the navel, along the side-waist hollow and on the inner arms. The pale tile and bathtub provide only weak bounced fill, while the dark wood absorbs light and stays comparatively deep. The frosted glass behind the subject forms broad luminous patches. Do not introduce a rim light, beauty dish, softbox look or polished three-point studio lighting.  The image should feel as if it was taken through a mirror with the main camera of a recent flagship smartphone, approximately 24–28mm full-frame equivalent with an f/1.8-ish smartphone-lens feel and normal smartphone depth of field. Do not use portrait mode. The subject and wooden-door background should both remain readable. Preserve slight wide-angle perspective, mild digital grain in dark areas, subtle computational sharpening, small highlight clipping on the white shirt and frosted glass, uneven exposure and a barely noticeable handheld tilt. Do not perfectly correct the vertical lines, center the body mathematically, smooth the skin or remove every visual imperfection.  The overall mood is quiet, warm, private, restrained and casually self-aware, like an authentic at-home social-media mirror selfie rather than a polished campaign image. It should feel as though she had just changed into pajama pants and noticed the light while passing the bathroom mirror, so she raised the phone for one quick photo. The warm light had just settled across her abdomen; one hand is still resting beside the phone, and she seems as though she may lower it in the next second. The final result should look like an accidental real-life phone photo that happened to capture the light, body line and domestic atmosphere unusually well.

创作一张 9:16 高级城市概念海报，把同一座城市最有代表性的两种面貌、时代、地理或空间特征压进同一个画面。

画面建立两个彼此对望的城市世界：A 侧从画面一侧向中央密集生长，B 侧从另一侧向中央延伸，两侧拥有各自完整的建筑、道路、交通、人物和城市生活细节。通过夸张但可信的空间关系，让城市像从两个方向共同挤压、包围中央区域，形成强烈尺度感、纵深感和城市奇观。

两侧不能只是换颜色，而要通过建筑语言、时代特征、地理环境、交通方式、生活细节和光线真正体现【城市面貌 A】与【城市面貌 B】之间的关系。每一侧设置一个清晰的主视觉地标，其余城市元素逐级退后，形成近景、中景、远景和完整城市天际线。

中央保留一条较窄的天空、雾气、水域或城市裂隙作为视觉缓冲，两侧环境可适度伸入中央，使画面紧张但不混乱。整体采用高密度细节 × 清晰视觉层级，远看具有冲击力，近看能够发现有意义的城市信息。

标题【主标题】融入中央空间，字体设计应根据城市本身的性格重新设计，可参考碑刻、Art Deco、窄体城市字体、现代宋体或几何字体语言，而不是简单放置普通文字。只保留【英文副标题】等真正解释作品含义的信息，不加入随机英文、假参数、编号或无意义装饰文字。

保持写实城市质感与高级 Editorial Design 气质，建筑材质、道路、灯光、窗户、人物尺度和空气透视真实细腻；色彩由两种城市面貌的主题决定，在中央自然过渡。

重点：让海报首先是一件完整的城市视觉作品，每一个建筑、文字、色彩和细节都服务于城市主题，而不是模板化填充。

prompts.text:
I love these posters. I have done a bunch but they never get old. GPT 2.5 prompt: 

4 images: 1:1, do this for 4 famous scientists: WITH topic_identity AS ( 
    SELECT
        derive_display_word('[TOPIC]') AS display_word,
        infer_primary_visual_form('[TOPIC]') AS hero_form,
        infer_semantic_motifs('[TOPIC]', 5, 15) AS motifs,
        infer_motion_logic('[TOPIC]') AS motion,
        infer_accent_palette('[TOPIC]') AS palette
),

layout_candidates AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES
            ('hero_right_type_left'),
            ('hero_left_type_right'),
            ('central_collision'),
            ('diagonal_motion'),
            ('radial_expansion'),
            ('vertical_ascent'),
            ('fragmented_field'),
            ('AI_invented_layout')
    ) AS L(layout)
),

ranked_layouts AS (
    SELECT
        layout,
        (
            0.28 * topic_fit(layout, '[TOPIC]') +
            0.22 * typography_readability(layout) +
            0.18 * hero_clarity(layout) +
            0.14 * motion_strength(layout) +
            0.10 * motif_capacity(layout) +
            0.08 * visual_surprise(layout)
        ) AS score
    FROM layout_candidates
)

SELECT render_poster(
    display_word => display_word,
    hero         => hero_form,
    motifs       => motifs,
    motion       => motion,
    palette      => palette,
    layout       => (
        SELECT layout
        FROM ranked_layouts
        ORDER BY score DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ),
    style        => 'kinetic editorial print collage'
)
FROM topic_identity;

REVEAL MECHANISM: [viewpoint / light / alignment / rotation]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
MAIN COLOR: [accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where the main word becomes readable only when the spatial elements, viewpoint or light are correctly aligned.

The title should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition, but it must not simply be printed as normal text. Break the letterforms across physical structures so they appear fragmented or abstract from other viewpoints, then visually resolve into one clear word from the intended camera position.

For negative space, build the letters from openings cut through multiple architectural layers.
For shadows, let physical structures cast separate shapes that align into the word.
For rotating panels, split the typography across panels at different angles so they reconnect only at one precise phase.
For angled fins, distribute narrow slices of the word across repeated surfaces so the full title appears only from one viewing direction.

Keep perspective, scale, occlusion, lighting and geometry physically believable. The reveal should feel like a real installation rather than a digital overlay.

Use one strong accent color with a restrained architectural palette. Keep the typography bold, geometric and visually powerful when correctly aligned.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them as a scale reference or observer interacting naturally with the installation.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, anamorphic installation, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, clean hierarchy and strong visual impact.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

【主题】：
【主视觉对象】：
【中文核心字】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【物理关系】：投影 / 反射 / 转印 / 覆盖揭示 / 其他
【档案信息】：结构图 / 材料 / 尺寸 / 过程 / 局部样本 / 其他
【主题色】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 East Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster 与文化出版物质感的竖版海报。

使用“非均衡三分构图”，让画面中的三个区域分别承担：

1. 主视觉对象
2. 巨型中文标题
3. 档案与辅助信息

不要平均切成三栏，也不要画明显分割线。

最重要的是，根据【物理关系】设计至少一处真实的跨区互动，让三个区域产生因果关系：

例如主体产生放大投影、镜面反射文字、印刷纸从版面揭起、拓片卷起露出原件等。

不要只是让元素彼此靠近，要让它们真正发生遮挡、穿插、反射、转印或前后揭示。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸，搭配墨黑 Typography 和一个主要主题色。中文采用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，英文标题使用 Serif，小型档案信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace。

主视觉必须具有明显大形，缩略图也能成立。巨型【中文核心字】要参与空间关系，可以被影子穿过、被镜面反射、出现在印刷结果中，或与真实物体形成前后层级。

加入与主题真正相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、尺寸、工艺步骤、结构剖面、表面样本或观察记录，让海报既有视觉冲击，也有内容深度。

信息密度保持中高，但至少保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成“主视觉高密、档案中密、纸面低密”的节奏。

最终阅读顺序：

第一眼看到强主视觉与巨大中文；第二眼发现跨区的物理关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或过程；第四眼阅读作品标题与档案信息。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级和编辑气质，但每张根据不同【物理关系】重新设计构图，不做模板换皮。

Another prompt for landing page design, done with GPT Image 2.5. I just feed these to Opus or Sol and ask it to turn them into an interactive website. 

Prompt: 16:9, 2x2 grid, do this for an unusual but real classic motorcycles INPUT = [ TOPIC / HERO_OBJECT / BRAND_TEMPERAMENT / VIEWPORT / GRAVITY_LAW ] 

Run HERO_PRODUCT_GRAVITY:

TOPIC_DNA      := infer the category from TOPIC alone — what's sold, who buys it,
                  what its shelf looks like
HERO_DNA       := ONE photographic hero object, cut out, oversized, 30–40% of frame;
                  real material response — specular on foil, matte on paper,
                  subsurface scatter on skin or fruit
BRAND_DNA      := derive the palette FROM the object — 1 dominant, 1 accent pulled
                  from a hue the object actually contains, 1 near-neutral ground
LIGHT_ANCHOR   := decide key light position ONCE (upper-left or upper-right); every
                  shadow — object, cards, pills, floating confetti — falls the same
                  direction at the same angle and softness
GRAVITY_LAW    := the hero is either GROUNDED (contact shadow touching a visible
                  surface plane) or SUSPENDED (ambient occlusion beneath, blur growing
                  with height) — never both, never floating with a hard cast shadow
                  and no plane to cast it onto
DEPTH_ORDER    := ground wash < decorative rays/confetti < hero object < UI chrome.
                  Nav, cart and buttons are ALWAYS in front, never occluded
TYPE_LOGIC     := one display face for the headline (heavy — pick condensed OR wide,
                  not both), one neutral for everything else; headline ≤ 6 words,
                  body renders as legible micro-type, never enlarged gibberish
IMPERFECTION   := exactly one element breaks its bounding box — a badge rotated 4–7°,
                  a sticker overlapping the product silhouette, a stray mark in the gutter
FRAME          := desktop 16:10, 64–80px outer gutter; the bottom edge reveals the top
                  15% of the next section so the page reads as scrollable
MOOD           := appetite, immediacy, one unmistakable action

Render: one screen where the product's own light governs every pixel of interface around it.

Forbidden — objects: stock-photo humans, lorem blocks at display size, a second competing hero
Forbidden — look: conflicting shadow directions, cut-out halo or chewed edges, cast shadows
on flat 2D illustration, palette colors absent from the object, three type families,
nav bar sitting behind the product

Create a bright, high-impact 9:16 anime editorial poster featuring one One Piece character using their signature ability.

Use clean 2D shonen anime illustration, bold ink outlines, vivid cel shading, expressive facial features, exaggerated but coherent perspective, and colors that remain clear and saturated. Keep the background white or cool off-white; avoid yellowed paper, brown shadows, dark vintage filters, and muted colors.

Build the composition around one oversized English word. The letters should occupy most of the frame, extend beyond the canvas, and function as part of the environment. Place the sky, ocean, sails, harbor, ruins, clouds, or architecture inside the letterforms.

Connect the typography naturally to the physical scene:
- let the lower letterforms meet the deck, stone steps, or ruins;
- extend ground perspective lines into the letters;
- cast consistent shadows across both typography and scenery;
- allow ropes, masts, weapons, hair, clothing, and effects to pass through the negative spaces.

The character must occupy the middle layer, while one signature element breaks strongly into the foreground. Keep the anatomy, hands, weapons, and mechanical details clear.

Four directions:

1. RUBBER IMPACT — Luffy lunges from a sunny ship deck, one stretched fist enlarged toward the camera. Bright ocean, sails, clouds, and islands fill the giant IMPACT letters.

2. STORM CALL — Nami rotates across the deck while pointing the Clima-Tact toward the viewer. A localized blue-white storm forms inside the STORM letters, with warm sunlight and cool lightning illuminating the same scene.

3. THREE BLADE — Zoro performs a low three-sword strike in a bright harbor. One blade dominates the foreground, while the other two create middle and rear spatial layers through the BLADE typography.

4. FLOWER TRACE — Robin stands calmly among sunlit coastal ruins. Use only one enlarged foreground hand and two separated secondary ability arms. Let them emerge from different parts of the BLOOM letters without creating a dense wall of hands.

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster that transforms the selected abstract concept into a monumental surreal spatial environment.

Do not simply design a building and place typography over it. The architecture itself must be generated from the logic of the concept.

Translate the theme into one clear spatial metaphor. Transit can become disconnected suspended platforms and passages. Time can become arcs, sunlight, long shadows and observation structures. Sound can become acoustic ribs, suspended panels and reverberation spaces. Memory can become fragmented rooms, doors, corridors and traces of human presence. For other themes, invent an equally direct architectural metaphor rather than reusing these examples mechanically.

Choose one dominant architectural gesture and build the entire composition around it. Avoid combining too many structural ideas. The image should have one immediately recognizable spatial identity even at small thumbnail size.

Integrate the main typography physically into the architecture. Large words, numbers or data should exist on different walls, platforms, curved surfaces, rooms or structural elements, following real perspective, scale, cropping, depth and occlusion. Typography may stretch across multiple spatial planes or only become readable from the chosen camera viewpoint. Never treat the main text as a flat graphic overlay.

Use the main typography as the visual hook. It should be simple enough to read quickly but surprising enough to make the viewer notice how it interacts with the space.

Add only a limited amount of secondary editorial information related to the theme, such as functional labels, measurements, timestamps, room information, observation data or short conceptual phrases. Keep many large surfaces completely blank so the design does not become a wall of text.

Populate the architecture with approximately 7 to 12 tiny adult human figures. Their poses should be natural and connected to the theme: waiting, walking, observing, listening, sitting, arriving or leaving. Keep people visually small so they establish scale, distance and emotional atmosphere rather than becoming portrait subjects.

Use large differences in architectural scale. Combine one or two monumental foreground structures with medium depth elements and several extremely small distant forms. Preserve clear foreground, middle ground and background separation.

Create strong but believable light and shadow. Let light participate in the concept whenever relevant: long shadows for time, isolated warm rooms for memory, controlled pools of light for sound, or directional daylight for transit. Avoid decorative cinematic effects that do not serve the spatial idea.

Use a restrained palette of ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated atmospheric tones. Introduce only one muted accent color on a small percentage of the architecture so each variation develops its own identity while remaining part of the same series.

Use matte concrete, stone, glass or paper like architectural surfaces with subtle grain, graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Keep the final image closer to a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster or experimental editorial print than a glossy CGI render.

Maintain strong asymmetry, deliberate negative space and controlled information density. Avoid conventional presentation boards, regular grids and perfectly balanced layouts. The composition should feel carefully designed but never mechanically templated.

The final result should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and slightly melancholic, with typography, architecture, tiny humans, light and spatial depth operating as one coherent visual system.

提示词：

【古诗词】{填写诗词标题、作者及原文}
【海报主标题】{提取2–4个代表性汉字}
【核心意象】{如紫藤垂花、青绿飞檐、雨后海棠、罗扇流萤}
【画面场景】{如江南庭院、临水村落、古典园林}
【视觉关系】{如花蔓垂落、红绿映衬、花木包围建筑}
【主色调】{选择2–3种协调的东方传统色}
【画幅比例】9:16

根据古诗词创作一张具有教科书级插画质感的新中式细线设色艺术海报，将诗中的花木、建筑、人物与情绪转化为完整、精致的东方诗意场景。

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

花木根据真实生长形态进行艺术化概括，紫藤保持自然垂挂，海棠花簇疏密有序，枝叶线条优雅流畅。以完整色面表现植物整体形态，不逐片描绘密集花瓣与树叶。

传统建筑采用精细规整的青绿色瓦片、优雅飞檐、暖白墙面与少量朱红木结构。整体平面化、设色饱满均匀，具有干净、哑光、细腻的纸本装饰质感。

【构图与空间】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成。

通过花木包围、枝条穿插、建筑遮挡、自然曲线与大面积暖米白留白组织画面，形成清晰的视觉重心和空间层次。

根据诗词灵活调整构图，突出最有代表性的景物与动作关系。建筑精描、植物概括、人物简练、背景留白。

避免反复使用固定的庭院布局，不强行添加无关的亭台、人物或装饰。地面和水面保持简洁，只用少量细线及不规则墨色阴影表现空间。

【东方配色】

采用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、藤紫、粉赭、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。

以一种主色形成视觉重量，通过另一种对比色突出花木、建筑或人物主体，搭配墨色细线与暖白留白。

强调完整的大色面、协调的冷暖关系与清晰的明度层次。色彩浓郁而克制，均匀、哑光、不褪色，避免颜色杂乱、复杂渐变、厚重纹理与过度做旧。

【中文艺术海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边的深色树冠区域，融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体，与花木色块形成自然叠压。

在适当留白处加入精致的小型纵排原诗句、准确的作者署名，以及一至两枚朱红印章。

文字清晰，层级分明，与景观自然融合，不添加虚构展览信息、编号或无意义装饰。

【最终质量】

保持完整的大色块构成、柔软云团树冠、纤细连续墨线、精致青绿建筑与优美留白。主体与辅助景物具有明确的细节层级，诗词意象符合自然规律。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立花叶、繁杂建筑、复杂地面、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张画风统一、配色高级、诗意鲜明、具有成熟东方装饰美学的新中式古诗词艺术海报。

prompts.text:
Prompt：

【主题 / 作品名】：____
【左侧内容】：____
【右侧内容】：____
【左右关系】：整体与局部 / 原始与结果 / 瞬间与延展 / 密集与留白 / 其他
【跨区连接方式】：主体越界 / 材质转译 / 色彩延展 / 云雾过渡 / 动作轨迹 / 其他
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 与展览视觉质感的左右构图海报。

核心不是把画面机械地平均分成左右两半，而是建立两个功能不同、视觉重量不同，但彼此存在明确关系的视觉区域。

左右比例不要固定 50:50，可根据内容采用 35:65、40:60、45:55、60:40 等不等比例关系，通过主体大小、色彩深浅、信息密度和留白完成视觉配重。

左、右两侧应承担不同视觉任务，例如：一侧展示完整主体，另一侧放大局部纹理；一侧呈现原始材料，另一侧展示其转化后的视觉结果；一侧定格人物或物体，另一侧延展动作、轨迹或能量；一侧保持高密度图像，另一侧用大面积留白和 Typography 完成平衡。

最重要的是“中间边界”。不要使用生硬竖线直接分栏，而要让至少一种核心元素跨越左右区域，使两侧真正连接起来：

主体局部自然越界；材质由实体逐渐变成平面图像；颜色、墨迹或纹理跨区延展；动作轨迹从主体一侧延伸到另一侧；云雾、光影或空间结构在边界处自然消散。让中轴成为“关系发生的位置”，而不是简单的分隔线。

Typography 根据作品内容组织。主标题、作品短句和辅助信息都必须与主题本身有关，不使用“左右构图”“设计案例”“视觉研究”等模板化占位文字。

文字可以参与左右配重：图像较重的一侧减少文字，留白较多的一侧增加标题或信息；也可以让标题跨越边界，与主体产生穿插。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系。左右可以存在明显冷暖、明暗或材质反差，但需要有至少一种颜色、纹理或文字系统作为视觉连接，避免看起来像两张图片硬拼在一起。

保留足够呼吸空间，通过：不等比例、视觉配重、主体越界、材质转译、疏密变化、Typography 穿插建立有设计感的左右关系。

最终阅读顺序应清晰：第一眼感受到左右两侧的视觉反差；第二眼发现中轴处的连接或变化；第三眼理解两个区域之间的内容关系；最后阅读标题与作品信息。

整体要求：左右关系明确但不生硬，两个区域各有作用又属于同一件作品，有视觉层次、有内容逻辑、有成熟 Editorial Poster 质感。

Prompt:

Turn the uploaded portrait into a Japanese beauty magazine cover.

Theme: [beauty topic]
Magazine title: [magazine name]
Main cover story: [headline]
Accent color: [color]
Issue: [month / year]

Keep the person recognizable and preserve the original face, hairstyle, pose, body direction, and overall portrait composition.

Build the editorial layout around the portrait instead of forcing the image into a fixed template.

Analyze the face position, hair silhouette, gaze direction, shoulders, hands, and available negative space, then adapt the typography accordingly:

* Let the oversized serif masthead interact naturally with the head or hair, with partial overlap where appropriate.
* Place cover lines mainly in clean negative-space areas rather than covering important facial features.
* Use the subject’s gaze and body direction to guide the reading flow.
* Reduce text density when the portrait is tightly cropped; use more surrounding information when more negative space is available.
* Allow typography to overlap hair, clothing, or background when it improves depth, but keep the eyes, nose, and lips visually clear.
* Use clear XXL / L / M / XS type hierarchy instead of evenly sized text.

Create a convincing Japanese beauty-magazine aesthetic: muted low-saturation colors, slightly gray tonal balance, soft diffused beauty photography, natural skin texture, lifted blacks, compressed highlights, subtle film grain, and a lightly faded print-magazine feel.

Include 4–6 meaningful beauty-related cover lines, one small editorial badge or information module, and one strong main cover story. Avoid meaningless filler text.

The final image should feel like a real published beauty magazine cover, while the composition changes naturally to fit each individual portrait.
